## Nerizo Demon (CR 9)

**XP** 6,400  
CE Medium outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)  
**Init** +2; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +19  

**Defense**

 **AC** 22, touch 12, flat-footed 20 (+2 Dex, +10 natural)  
**hp** 125 (10d10+70)  
**Fort** +14, **Ref** +9, **Will** +7  
**DR** 10/good; **Immune** electricity, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10, fire 10; **SR** 20  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +16 (1d6+6), sting +16 (1d8+6 plus poison)  
**Special Attacks** spit acid (10-ft. line, 4d6 acid damage, Ref DC 22 half, usable every 1d4+1 rounds)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 12th)  

 At will—darkness, detect good, greater teleport (self plus 50 pounds of objects only)  
1/day—confusion (DC 17), summon (level 4, 2d10 dretches or 1 nerizo 35%)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 23, **Dex** 15, **Con** 25, **Int** 12, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +16; **CMD** 28  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Cleave, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Stealth), Iron Will  
**Skills** Acrobatics +2 (+10 jump),Climb +19, Diplomacy +8, Escape Artist +10, Intimidate +16, Perception +19, Sense Motive +15, Stealth +21, Survival +15; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +8 Acrobatics to jump  
**Languages** Abyssal  

**Special Abilities**

 **Posion (Ex)** Sting—injury; *save* Fort DC 22; *frequency* 1 round for 4 rounds; *effect* 1d2 Str; *cure* 1 save. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (Abyss)  
**Organization** solitary or pack (2–5)  
**Treasure** standard
